content.short: Laevitas provides quantitative token data analytics for crypto traders.
content.description: Laevitas is a Bitcoin and Ethereum token data analytics platform that delivers quantitative insights to crypto traders. Users can sign up to access data on options, futures, and derivatives presented on customizable dashboards, empowering informed decisions across markets. For developers and investment houses, the Laevitas API provides access to additional historical data to support comprehensive chart analysis and research workflows.
content.meta: Laevitas is a Bitcoin and Ethereum token data analytics platform providing quantitative insight to crypto traders. Discover Laevitas and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
